name: @naklitechie/khata-conformance
description: Cross-implementation conformance package for the .khata accounting format: format spec, a 3-file / 53-invariant corpus, golden report fixtures, and a byte-for-byte CI harness. Keeps every engine (Bahi's JS, Folio's Ruby, any third-party reader) faithful to the same contract.
author: Chirag Patnaik (@NakliTechie)

scripts.test: node harness/run.mjs --adapter 'node adapters/js/adapter.mjs' && node harness/run.mjs --adapter 'ruby adapters/ruby/adapter.rb' && python3 harness/format_suite.py
